research_questions: How do deterministic static and predicted-coverage rankings compare with random selection under paired count and predicted-cost budgets on training-pool replay?
How variable are paired gains across predefined seeds, and how often do predicted cost budgets overrun observed cycles?
How does the historical saturated initial-coverage result differ from predefined partial-coverage replay and training-pool active-learning replay?

conditions.interpretation: Previously inspected; subsequent use is exploratory only; preserve zero gains.

conditions.candidate_population: training logical tests not in paired initial set
conditions.initial_policy: seeded random sample without replacement from train; same IDs across paired policies per seed and simulator
conditions.evaluation_population: training pool; exploratory replay, no generalization claim

conditions.interpretation: Separate population/condition; do not pool with partial replay or held-out results.

budgets.cost_estimate_source: Stage 11 predicted_cycles; actual candidate costs evaluation only
budgets.overrun_rule: report max(0, observed_cycles - predicted_budget); never feed actual candidate cost to predictive rankings

metrics: reachable coverage versus selected test count
reachable coverage versus predicted and observed cycles
normalized trapezoidal AUC by test count and observed cycles
mean and standard deviation across seeds
predicted and observed cost and overrun
cost to predefined attainable coverage targets with explicit unreached status
model fit and inference overhead separately

model_overhead.stage11_fitting: not repeated; frozen model outputs reused
model_overhead.stage11_inference: Frozen selected coverage models are inferred on training candidates in-sample; elapsed inference is reported separately in the output manifest.
model_overhead.overhead_seconds: Coverage-model inference time is measured separately; Stage 11 fitting is not repeated.

stopping_rules.count: stop at requested count or candidate exhaustion
stopping_rules.cost: stop before next item whose predicted cost exceeds budget; report actual overrun after evaluation
stopping_rules.unreached: emit explicit unreached marker; do not extrapolate

replication_unit: seed-level paired replay on one logical-test training pool; simulator counterparts are repeated views, not independent samples; rounds and near-duplicate programs are not independent replicates
heldout_policy: No tuning or configuration decisions from test labels. Previously reported test outcomes are already inspected. Any further use is exploratory, not a new blind evaluation.
negative_and_inconclusive: Retain zero-gain, saturated, overrun, and unreached outcomes. No significance or generalization claims supported by this corpus.

plots.captions: Include population, condition, denominator, units, seed count, and exploratory status.

policy_audit_correction.reason: Stage 11 prediction export contains validation/test only; frozen Stage 11 models are now applied to training candidates without refitting. The predicted policies are explicitly in-sample exploratory replay.
policy_audit_correction.prediction_scope: frozen Stage 11 selected models inferred on their own training candidates; no retraining or generalization claim.
policy_audit_correction.oracle_label_correction: actual_label_oracle_greedy_baseline is a greedy actual-label baseline; no mathematical upper-bound guarantee is claimed.

execution_provenance.hash_capture: captured at run start; inputs/configuration/source rechecked before successful completion
